title: Filling Out a Job Application
subtitle: Asking the hiring manager about the form — for English learners

sentences.en: Hi, I picked up an application form this morning and I have a few questions.
sentences.target: Hi, I picked up an application form this morning and I have a few questions.

sentences.en: Sure, I can help. What part are you confused about?
sentences.target: Sure, I can help. What part are you confused about?

sentences.en: Under work history, should I include short-term jobs from more than five years ago?
sentences.target: Under work history, should I include short-term jobs from more than five years ago?

sentences.en: List anything from the last seven years that's relevant to this position.
sentences.target: List anything from the last seven years that's relevant to this position.

sentences.en: There's a field for desired salary. Should I write a number or 'negotiable'?
sentences.target: There's a field for desired salary. Should I write a number or 'negotiable'?

sentences.en: 'Negotiable' is fine, but a range is even better — it shows you've done some research.
sentences.target: 'Negotiable' is fine, but a range is even better — it shows you've done some research.

sentences.en: Do I need to attach references with the application, or can I send them later?
sentences.target: Do I need to attach references with the application, or can I send them later?

sentences.en: You can email them after we contact you for an interview.
sentences.target: You can email them after we contact you for an interview.

sentences.en: When should I expect to hear back about whether I got an interview?
sentences.target: When should I expect to hear back about whether I got an interview?

sentences.en: We usually respond within two weeks. Feel free to follow up if you don't hear from us.
sentences.target: We usually respond within two weeks. Feel free to follow up if you don't hear from us.

sentences.en: Thank you so much. I really appreciate you taking the time to explain.
sentences.target: Thank you so much. I really appreciate you taking the time to explain.
